author: @FrankCurzio
text:
Last week was the craziest week in the markets since 2008.

I've been on Wall St for 30 years and I haven’t seen this much go wrong in five trading days since then. In case you missed any of it...

Here's a full recap - 11 things you need to know from last week:🧵

author: @FrankCurzio
text:
1. Nvidia lost its CEO (but is he coming back?)

A probe into Jensen Huang's affair with a woman reportedly suspected of spying for China wiped about $430B off Nvidia ( $NVDA ) in two days.

He resigned Thursday, but by Sunday he was reportedly talking about a comeback.
quoted_text:
BREAKING: Jensen Huang is considering returning to Nvidia, $NVDA, as CEO as tech executives pressure the company’s board to reinstate him, per FT.

Huang is reportedly discussing a potential return even as an independent investigation by Nvidia's board is underway.

One "ally" of Jensen Huang is reportedly putting together a "war room" of tech executives to lobby for his return.

It's going to be an interesting week to say the least.
